title: Why Does It Rain?
hook: Rain is not the sky crying.

shots.note: Storm cloud over a hill — rain, not tears
Warm air lifting vapor from the water

narration: Rain is not the sky crying.
The sky is not sad. Water is just moving.
The sun warms lakes, rivers, and the sea.
Warm air lifts tiny water bits you cannot see.
Let me show you that in 3D.
Those bits rise, cool, and stick together.
They join into heavier drops inside a cloud.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
When a drop gets too heavy, it falls.
That fall is rain, and it waters the ground.
Then the sun can lift the water up again.
It is a loop: up as vapor, down as rain.
Remember: rain is water on a trip, not the sky crying.
And that is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
description:
Why does it rain? A kid-safe cinematic Blender 3D short (ages 6–10).

The water cycle: sun, vapor, cloud, rain. Lighting HDRI: Poly Haven, CC0.
Made for Kids. Music: original kids bed (CC0, in-house).
